Reconcile two or more extractions

Source: R/submissions.R
reconcile.Rd

Combines extractions of the same study into the accepted data. Values on which all extractions agree are taken as they are; disagreements must be resolved with choices (or taken from base with unresolved = "base"). provenance.csv records, for each data point, which extraction it came from and which other extractions agreed with it; values set by the arbiter are attributed to them with channel reconcile.

Usage

reconcile(
  path = ".",
  study_id,
  extraction_ids = NULL,
  base = NULL,
  choices = NULL,
  person,
  unresolved = c("error", "base")
)

Arguments

path

Project root.

study_id

Study id.

extraction_ids

Extractions to compare. Defaults to all pending submissions of the study.

base

Extraction whose values are used where nothing else is chosen. Defaults to the first one.

choices

Data frame resolving disagreements, with columns part, key, field (as in compare_extractions()) and either from (an extraction id to take the value from) or value (the value to use). For field = "(row)", from adds or keeps the data point from that extraction and value = "drop" removes it. For metadata, from takes the whole top-level field (key) from that extraction.

person

Id of the arbiter.

unresolved

What to do with disagreements not covered by choices: "error" (default) or "base".

Value

The study folder, invisibly.
